segments.name: Biotechnology
segments.description: Clinical-stage company developing hematopoietic stem cell gene therapies for solid tumors, led by the Temferon candidate.
segments.evidence: The Company and its chief operating decision-maker view the Company's current operations and the management of its biotech business in one (1) operating segment.

changes.text: In January 2026 the company discontinued its GU development program for Temferon in metastatic renal cell carcinoma.
changes.evidence: However, following the strategic review completed in January 2026, we discontinued the GU development program and we are no longer pursuing active clinical development in mRCC.
